blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Hockaday was little changed, 3 in June and 3 in October (+0.0%), and 3 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 0.8% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.

blocks.text: Hockaday home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

9 houses sold in Hockaday with a median price of $1,689,000 (the middle half sold between $1,560,000 and $2,560,000), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 22% sold above list. They had a median $519 per square foot, a median year built of 1995 and a median lot of 6,112 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Hockaday?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 3 houses listed in Hockaday. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Hockaday a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Hockaday had no published sales ratio for the month. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Hockaday from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Hockaday over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Hockaday?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Hockaday sell for?
faq.a: 9 houses sold in Hockaday between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,689,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Hockaday?
faq.a: The median was 32 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (22% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
